messages:
sahil: Heads-up — onboarding llama3-v1 weights to staging. I uploaded the tarball to GCS but noticed model-serving rejects requests with our chat template. Error looks like a tokenizer mismatch (BOS/EOS handling).

lina: thanks — path? I can try a quick local run.

sahil: gs://redwood-models/llama3-v1/weights-2026-03-15.tar.gz

aj: saw similar with a different model last week — usually special token mapping or an extra leading token in the chat template. Can you paste the failing prompt?

sahil: example root msg we send to runtime: ```{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are Assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the text."}]}``` runtime returns a 400 with: `tokenizer: unknown token sequence at position 0` and logs show decoder received an extra `<s>` in front but our tokenizer seems to add its own BOS too.

lina: quick tri: when you load the tokenizer locally what does encode look like? `tok.encode("You are Assistant.").tokens`

sahil: ran it: ["<s>","▁You","▁are","▁Assistant",".</s>"] so tokenizer has explicit `<s>` and `</s>`. Our chat template also prefixes a system delimiter `<|system|>` (legacy). So double-BOS.

aj: that explains the mismatch. Serving config currently has `trim_bos: false` for this model. We should either set `trim_bos: true` or strip the template BOS.

maya: pinging infra-bot to check if Dedicated staging uses tokenizer_overrides for this bundle.

infra-bot: deploy-check: model bundle manifest found at gs://redwood-models/llama3-v1/manifest.json. Detected tokenizer type: sentencepiece. Overrides present: none. Suggested validation: run `rwd-model-validate --tokenizer-check` before deploy.

lina: propose update to model config in manifest to avoid surprises. Suggested minimal change: ```yaml
tokenizer_overrides:
  add_bos: false
  special_tokens:
    bos_token: "<s>"
    eos_token: "</s>"
    pad_token: "<pad>"
serving:
  trim_bos: true
```

aj: LGTM. Also add a small unit check in onboarding pipeline that ensures `template + tokens` roundtrip equals tokens produced by runtime. Quick snippet I use: ```python
# check token counts
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file("tokenizer.json")
base = tok.encode("You are Assistant.").ids
with_template = tok.encode("<|system|> You are Assistant.").ids
assert not (with_template[0] == base[0] and base[0] == tok.token_to_id('<s>'))
```

sahil: I'll update the manifest and re-upload the tarball today. Also adding note in PR about chat templates: avoid legacy `<|system|>` when tokenizer already provides BOS.

maya: thanks. small ask for release notes: add "llama3-v1: tokenizer BOS/EOS alignment — manifest override option" under eng-ml changelog.

lina: tiny follow-up — can we add an automated check to the Checkout CI that runs `rwd-model-validate --tokenizer-check` for any new manifests? If infra-bot flags it we can block the rollout.

infra-bot: noted — creating ticket INFRA-2219 to add tokenizer-check gate to manifest pipeline.

aj: +1. If you need a quick patch I can wire the CI rule.

sahil: thanks all — I'll post the PR link when uploaded. :thumbsup:
